sections.thesis: The US added 165,000 jobs in October, more than double the 65,000 forecast, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will raise rates next month.

sections.thesis: The dollar held near a 1-1/2-year high against the euro after surging by the most in nearly six months on Friday, as robust US jobs data pushed up bets for higher rates.
